title: Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 pageant names 'Circle of Speakers'
summary: The delegates of the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant continue to prepare for the upcoming competition, learning how to speak with confidence through another learning session.…

blocks.text: The delegates of the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant continue to prepare for the upcoming competition, learning how to speak with confidence through another learning session. Toastmasters International (Philippines) conducted a session called “Voice of Beauty,” which the pageant said would sharpen the participants’ “public speaking, communication, and leadership skills while building confidence and finding their voices.” The activity also chose the “Circle of 5 Speakers,” which included the Philippines’ Gabrielle Galapia, Cambodia’s Ry Srey Neth, Colombia’s Maria Valentina Alzate, South Africa’s Nompumelelo Malindi and Guam’s Cyndal Abad.
